title: Resort Charge Payable on a Resort Lodging Stay
content:
The resort charge for a Resort Lodging stay is the nightly resort charge of the unit type for every night the folio shows the party occupied, posted to the folio as a single entry carrying the number of nights it covers. The amount is carried at full precision and the entry posted to the folio is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded to the cent whose last digit is even, which is the convention the collective's finance office settles every folio on.

The charge is therefore one nightly figure multiplied by a count of nights: the unit type's nightly resort charge, and the nights the folio shows the party occupied. The count of nights the entry carries is the same count the amount was worked out over.

| What is read | Where it is read |
| --- | --- |
| The unit type's nightly resort charge | the charge schedule published for the unit type |
| The nights the party occupied | the nights the reservation's folio shows consumed |

### A worked resort charge (hypothetical figures)

Take a folio showing 6 nights consumed on a stay, in a unit type whose nightly resort charge is taken here as 32.00 USD. The 6 nights at 32.00 USD a night give 192.00 USD, carried at full precision and rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end. The entry posted to the folio carries that amount and the 6 nights it covers.
